problem_statement: When VFS returns a directory entry, the name in vfs_dirent_t.d_name must be null-terminated and must contain the complete name, even for a name of the maximum length a filesystem can store. A test creates an entry with a name of that maximum length and expects vfs_readdir() to return the full name in d_name with a terminating zero. Today the returned name can be truncated or can lack a terminating zero.
